test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held on: 3 Feb 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: A and B can do a certain work in 25 and 20 days, respectively. They work together for 4 days. The remaining work is completed by C in 8 days. C alone can complete 40% of the original work in:
solution:
Given:

A and B can do a certain work in 25 and 20 days, respectively. They work together for 4 days.

The remaining work is completed by C in 8 days.

Concept used:

Total work = Efficiency (Work done per day) × Total time taken 

Calculation:

LCM (25, 20, 8) = 200

Let the total work be the LCM of the time taken by different workers.

So, total work = 200 units

The efficiency of A = 200/25 = 8 units

The efficiency of B = 200/20 = 10 units

Work done by A & B together in 4 days

⇒ (8 + 10) × 4

⇒ 72 units

Remaining work = (200 - 72) = 128 units

The efficiency of C = 128/8 = 16 units

Now, C alone can complete 40% of the original work in

⇒ (200/16) × 40%

⇒ 12.5 × 40%

⇒ 5 days

**∴ C alone can complete 40% of the original work in 5 days.**
